title: ESPN收购NFL网络后启动裁员 迪士尼旗下多部门波及
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For employees at Paramount Skydance and Warner Brothers Discovery, the fear that a merger will lead to mass payoffs is perhaps real.
segments.zh: 对于派拉蒙、天空之舞和华纳兄弟探索的员工来说，合并可能导致大规模裁员的担忧或许真实存在。

segments.en: Given what just happened at another media giant, Scarlet Foo has more on Disney.
segments.zh: 鉴于另一家媒体巨头刚刚发生的情况，Scarlet Foo带来迪士尼的更多消息。

segments.en: Scarlet. That's right, Danny. Disney's ESPN this week began a round of layoffs tied to its takeover of the NFL network and the league's other media assets last year.
segments.zh: Scarlet：没错，Danny。迪士尼旗下ESPN本周开始裁员，这与去年收购NFL网络及联盟其他媒体资产有关。

segments.en: According to a staff memo, ESPN Chairman Jimmy Petaro said that the sports broadcaster and streamer has made significant progress integrating these NFL assets.
segments.zh: 据员工备忘录，ESPN主席Jimmy Pitaro表示，这家体育广播和流媒体公司在整合NFL资产方面取得了重大进展。

segments.en: And that throughout this process, they've evaluated teams, resources and organizational structure, resulting in what he calls job impacts.
segments.zh: 在此过程中，他们评估了团队、资源和组织结构，导致了所谓的岗位影响。

segments.en: The memo did not specify the number of job cuts, but we know some high profile staffers were affected, including on-air analysts Ryan Clark, formerly of the Pittsburgh Steelers,
segments.zh: 备忘录未说明裁员人数，但一些知名员工受到影响，包括前匹兹堡钢人队分析师Ryan Clark。

segments.en: and Carl Ravich, a 33-year veteran of ESPN, who handled play-by-play coverage of baseball and college basketball.
segments.zh: 以及ESPN 33年老将Carl Ravich，他负责棒球和大学篮球的实况解说。

segments.en: Both of them were let go. And it's not just ESPN either.
segments.zh: 两人均被解雇。而且不仅仅是ESPN。

segments.en: Disney announced layoffs at its other divisions, including Pixar Animation Studios, home to the Toy Story franchise, as well as National Geographic.
segments.zh: 迪士尼宣布其他部门也进行裁员，包括皮克斯动画工作室和国家地理。

segments.en: Remember, ESPN's purchase of the NFL network was worth some $2-3 billion in contrast to the $110 billion Paramount Warner Brothers sale you were just talking about, which, as we know,
segments.zh: 记住，ESPN收购NFL网络耗资约20-30亿美元，而您刚才提到的派拉蒙华纳兄弟交易价值1100亿美元。

segments.en: state regulators fear will lead to much more extensive job cuts.
segments.zh: 州监管机构担心这将导致更大规模的裁员。
